description.en: Bundles I actually run, pinned to published npm versions.
description.zh: 本机实际在跑的插件集合，固定到已发布的 npm 版本。

plugins.name: dshmarket
plugins.description: Visual plugin market inside DeepSeek Harness — browse, search, and one-click install community plugins. · DSH 可视化插件市场：逛一逛，点一下，装好。

plugins.name: dsh-better-sidebar
plugins.description: Better Sidebar for DSH — file tree, editor, changes, tasks and side chat in one column, separate for every conversation. Also exposes a service other plugins use to register sidebar tabs and file viewers.

plugins.name: dsh-plugin-dev-kb
plugins.description: dsh 插件开发知识库：DeepSeek Harness 官方文档站完整 Markdown 镜像（中英双语 188 页）+ 182 篇仓库补充开发参考 + 主题导航与 373 文件全量搜索索引；以 dsh-plugin-dev-kb 技能让 agent 在插件开发任务中自动加载定位文档。纯数据插件，零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: dsh-ops
plugins.description: Provides bash, PowerShell 7, and a suite of high-performance tools written in Rust for Windows DSH to enhance token efficiency

plugins.name: dsh-free-search
plugins.description: Free web search for DeepSeek Harness: 24 engines (Bing/DuckDuckGo/AnySearch/SearXNG/Exa/Tavily/Keenable/Firecrawl/Parallel keyless; Zhihu global/site via MCP and Perplexity/SerpBase/DeepSeek/You.com/Baidu/Kimi/Aliyun/Doubao with key; OpenAI/Gemini/Claude

plugins.name: dsh-context
plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for context insight and management, with context dashboard and context command, for understanding how the context is made of, and how it evolves.
plugins.author: bowenliang123

plugins.name: dsh-pocket
plugins.description: 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进你的口袋：一个包、一个设置页，手机扫码即同步访问电脑上的 DSH（局域网 + 公网，实时同屏）。

plugins.name: dsh-recall-plugin
plugins.description: 在 DSH 中撤回自己发过的消息：工作区文件与对话历史一起回到那条消息发出之前，消息的文本与附件自动放回输入框，改完即可重发。文件走独立影子 git 快照（不碰项目自身的 git），对话走官方 sessions.fork，原会话归档可找回。

plugins.name: dsh-notify-me
plugins.description: DSH 桌面消息提醒插件：模型需要你操作（审批/方案确认/提问的可操作提醒）或回复在后台完成时，系统通知+提示音+标签页标题提醒你；权限审批的通知上可直接点「同意/拒绝」完成裁决；可把提醒转发到 Discord Webhook / Bark / Gotify / 自定义 Webhook 等外部通知；可在设置页开关并切换通知语言。Desktop notification & message alerts for DeepSeek Harness web — toasts, sounds and a tab-
plugins.author: chromoany

plugins.name: dsh-whale-widget
plugins.description: DSH Web 界面右下角的 DeepSeek 余额小鲸鱼挂件:余额/今日已用/峰谷定价、自定义泡泡点击序列(文本/余额/今日/峰谷/图片/随机语句与并列加权选择)、逐行样式与字体、悬浮快捷编辑、音效与每轮消耗、自定义角色/动图/音效、吸附与翻转自定义

plugins.name: dsh-skin-market
plugins.description: Native skin marketplace and lifecycle manager for DeepSeek Harness

plugins.name: dsh-computer-use-win
plugins.description: Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness: an MCP stdio server + PowerShell UIA backend, bridged into DSH via @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client. Read/act on real Windows desktop apps (UI Automation tree, screenshots, typed input, OCR, window management).
plugins.author: Yu-tao-Li

plugins.description: Bring ChatGPT-like image generation to DeepSeek Harness — Gemini, OpenAI, Seedream, DashScope, local ComfyUI & more.
plugins.author: shanliuling

plugins.description: DSH skill center: browse loaded skills by source (bundled / project / user / custom / runtime), enable or disable, create and delete, in a web GUI panel.

plugins.name: @michengai/dsh-agency-agents
plugins.description: DSH Agency Agents — 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 331 名可召唤的专业智能体 · 331 summonable domain experts for DeepSeek Harness

plugins.name: @michengai/dsh-skills-manager
plugins.description: DSH Skills Manager — 在 DeepSeek Harness 中统一加载并安全管理本机 Agent Skills · Load and safely manage local Agent Skills in DSH

plugins.name: @tt-a1i/archify-dsh
plugins.description: Opt-in DeepSeek Harness Skill-only bundle for the Archify architecture-diagram skill.

plugins.description: Persistent inline image, video, and audio previews for DeepSeek Harness Web conversations, with workspace-confined local reads and an optional ComfyUI proxy.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness tool plugin that exposes BrowserSkill browser automation (bsk_* tools) to the model
